fields.subject: Cyber 1 Required for Isolation
fields.body:
Per CISA and MS-ISAC protocols, network isolation for MCHD-INT01 and MCHD-FS01 must be initiated immediately to prevent ransomware propagation.

The attacker is using a malicious script ('auto_cleaner.py') on MCHD-INT01 to delete and alter entries in the IIS export file. The script has already removed 142 records and is running every 15 minutes.

This is a confirmed breach. We cannot proceed without a formal Cyber 1 declaration from the Incident Commander. We recommend immediate activation of EOP Level 1.

Failure to act now may result in irreversible data corruption and loss of essential public health functions.
fields.signature:
County IT
Marston County Health Department
MC-IT-2026 | x2015
